$comment: Q49/GR-10 Android manifest permission allowlist for the release AAB of the ONE public Wayvro app. A permission not listed here fails CI. Adding one requires a requirement ID, a just-in-time request design and founder review (CLAUDE.md §9). `${applicationId}` is substituted by the checker.
phase: Phase 3 (P3.5): account slice, Driver/Partner onboarding capture and rider foreground location (FA-02 APPROVED 2026-10-12: COARSE + FINE only)

allowed.name: android.permission.INTERNET
allowed.justification: API, realtime and update traffic. Normal (install-time) permission, no runtime prompt.

allowed.name: ${applicationId}.DYNAMIC_RECEIVER_NOT_EXPORTED_PERMISSION
allowed.justification: Signature-level permission AndroidX core declares for non-exported dynamic broadcast receivers on API < 33. Grants nothing to other apps.

allowed.name: android.permission.CAMERA
allowed.justification: P2.8 Driver/Partner onboarding only: document photos and one selfie for MANUAL review (no liveness, no face matching). Requested just in time on the capture screen after an in-app explanation, never at start-up and never for rider-only users; denial falls back to the system Photo Picker for documents (no media permission) or the in-person explanation for the selfie.

allowed.name: android.permission.ACCESS_FINE_LOCATION
allowed.justification: Phase 3 rider pickup: foreground (when-in-use) only, requested just in time at the first 'Use current location' tap after an in-app rationale, together with COARSE; approximate-only grants are handled by asking the rider to confirm a pin. Never requested at start-up, never in the background, never for the Driver/Partner area in Phase 3. Denial falls back to search, pin and pickup points.

allowed.name: android.permission.ACCESS_COARSE_LOCATION
allowed.justification: Requested together with FINE (Android 12+ requires both); an approximate-only grant biases search and centres the pin, never sets a pickup by itself.

forbidden.name: android.permission.USE_FULL_SCREEN_INTENT
forbidden.reason: M26/ADR-033: ride offers never depend on full-screen intents; not requested by default.

forbidden.name: android.permission.ACCESS_BACKGROUND_LOCATION
forbidden.reason: Driver-only, gated behind SP-01 and an approved driver flow; never in the Phase 1 shell.

forbidden.name: android.permission.FOREGROUND_SERVICE_LOCATION
forbidden.reason: Driver-only location foreground service; gated behind SP-01.

forbidden.name: android.permission.FOREGROUND_SERVICE
forbidden.reason: Phase 3 has no foreground service; the driver location FGS is Phase 4 after SP-01/ADR-029.

forbidden.name: android.permission.WAKE_LOCK
forbidden.reason: No background work in Phase 3; Phase 4 decides with ADR-029.

forbidden.name: android.permission.RECEIVE_BOOT_COMPLETED
forbidden.reason: Tracking never restarts on boot; resume is explicit (role model section 6).

forbidden.name: android.permission.RECORD_AUDIO
forbidden.reason: No audio feature is approved (ADR-021 open).

forbidden.name: android.permission.SYSTEM_ALERT_WINDOW
forbidden.reason: Development-only overlay; must never reach a release build.

forbidden.name: android.permission.READ_EXTERNAL_STORAGE
forbidden.reason: Not needed; scoped storage/photo picker only when a feature requires it.

forbidden.name: android.permission.READ_MEDIA_IMAGES
forbidden.reason: P2.8 imports use the system Photo Picker, which needs no media permission.

forbidden.name: android.permission.READ_MEDIA_VISUAL_USER_SELECTED
forbidden.reason: System Photo Picker only; no partial media-library access.

forbidden.name: android.permission.ACCESS_MEDIA_LOCATION
forbidden.reason: Photo location metadata is never read.

forbidden.name: android.permission.READ_PHONE_STATE
forbidden.reason: Not needed; device identifiers are not collected.

forbidden.name: android.permission.POST_NOTIFICATIONS
forbidden.reason: Requested just in time when notifications ship (Phase 4+), not by the shell.
